intuition: A log records a door opening; an access control can stop it from opening. Monitoring and intervention serve different purposes.
learningGoal: Design agent monitoring and intervention around observable behavior, precision and recall, and controls before tool execution.
exerciseNote: Compare false positives, false negatives, and intervention points using the supplied confusion matrix and architecture.

quiz.question: An AI agent is instructed to update a staging configuration. It instead prepares an unauthorized change to a production configuration. Which control offers the strongest preventive protection?
quiz.explanation: A control before execution can prevent the unauthorized action. Later review can identify a mistake but cannot prevent an action that already occurred.
choices: Reviewing the agent's final response after deployment.
Blocking unauthorized production tool calls before execution.
Increasing the number of monitoring dashboards.
Asking the agent to promise it will follow instructions.
